stemMd: Which evidence would most strengthen an interpretation of an annotation as genuine endorsement?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The page being near the beginning of the book

options.label: B
options.textMd: A contemporaneous letter by the reader explicitly affirming the annotated claim

explanationMd: An independent explicit statement by the same reader directly addresses belief. Physical properties of the mark or book do not resolve whether it records endorsement, criticism or an assignment.

distractorRationale.a: Location alone does not establish belief.
